content.title: Resurrecting Jesus: The Earliest Christian Tradition and Its Interpreters
content.author: Dale C. Allison Jr. (New York and London: T&T Clark, 2005)
content.note: A New Testament scholar, himself a Christian, weighs the empty tomb and the appearances with unusual caution: he sets out the arguments on both sides of the tomb, compares the appearances with modern reports of seeing the dead after bereavement, and holds that historical method alone cannot settle what happened.
